profile.headline: Software Engineer | Full-Stack, Systems & AI | Ex-Perforce Software | Built 100k+ LOC Java Project
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer focused on building scalable systems, full-stack applications, and AI-powered tools.
Professionally, I spent nearly 3 years at Perforce Software, contributing across backend server development, Qt desktop applications, and modern web clients built with TypeScript and Angular.
Outside of work, I maintain SurvivalPlus, a 100k+ line Java project I’ve been architecting since 2018 designing modular gameplay systems, multiplayer infrastructure, progression mechanics, and performance-critical game systems.

My current interests include:
 AI integrations 
 Full-stack product development 
 Distributed systems 
 Developer tooling 

Open to software engineering opportunities, collaborations, and ambitious technical projects.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and deployed custom websites for small businesses, enhancing their online presence.  
• Managed client requests to transform ideas into functional websites and applications.  
• Utilized modern responsive design techniques to improve client acquisition.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · Web Engineering · Web Development · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Linux

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborated with companies to modernize their infrastructure and refactor web applications.  
• Managed subcontractors, developers, and client relationships while maintaining technical work.  
• Optimized existing applications to enhance performance and improve customer retention.
positions.insights: Skills: Back-End Web Development · Project Management · Software Infrastructure · Web Engineering · Web Development · REST APIs · Agile Development · Systems Design · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Solution Architecture · Software Architecture · Technical Leadership · Software Design · Linux · Agile Methodologies · Node.js · Git

positions.title: Project Lead Developer
positions.description:
•​ Designed and built an AI-powered full-stack productivity platform using TypeScript, React, Tailwind, and Express 
• Architected a multi-database infrastructure using AWS, Postgres, Google Cloud Firestore, and Pinecone vector search
•​ Implemented OAuth integrations with Google and AI-driven memory retrieval systems 
• Designed modular AI workflows for document generation, sandboxed rendering, image generation, and dynamic tool orchestration

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed backend server functionality for enterprise ALM software, enhancing efficiency for engineering teams.  
• Built and maintained desktop client features using Qt/C++, ensuring a seamless user experience.  
• Created modern web client functionality with TypeScript and Angular, improving accessibility and performance.  
• Designed integrations with tools like Slack and Jira, facilitating better collaboration across teams.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Back-End Web Development · Software Infrastructure · Java · Client-Server Model · Web Engineering · Web Development · REST APIs · API Development · Agile Development · Systems Design · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Solution Architecture · C++ · Software Architecture · Optimizing Performance · Technical Leadership · Software Design · Enterprise Software · Client-server Application Development · Angular · Distributed Systems · Agile Methodologies · Gradle · Node.js · Git

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Worked with students in a higher-level Computer Science course (CSE 274), helping them problem solve and troubleshoot their code.
• Worked with students in an intro level object-oriented Java programming course (CSE 271) helping students learn the fundamentals of object-oriented programming.
• Worked together with other Teaching Assistants to grade student works in a timely and efficient manner.

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed websites using the WordPress platform for the freelancing company.
• Utilized HTML5 and CSS 3 to develop custom themes and designs for clients
• Used PhP while closely working with clients to develop custom plugins for the WordPress platform

projects.title: SurvivalPlus — Large-Scale Java Multiplayer Systems Project
projects.description: Designed and maintained a 100k+ line Java codebase since 2018, building scalable multiplayer systems on PaperMC. Features include modular progression systems, questing, cosmetics, dungeon instancing, client-server communication, and performance-focused architecture.

projects.title: Task Athena — AI-Powered Goal & Task Management Platform
projects.description: Designed and developed a full-stack AI-driven productivity platform featuring conversational workflows, task management, database-backed persistence, and OpenAI integrations.
